LESSON: READING 2.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING – LIBRARY SKILLS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills, part of Strand 2 in Grade 8 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How do we get information on something we want to understand more? 2. Why is it important to use the internet safely and cautiously?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. search for texts related to technology, social media or the internet, using digital devices or the library,

2. collaborate with peers to conduct a silent reading session,

3. list down the vocabulary identified from the read texts,

4. pick out names of digital devices from the texts, read and write them on charts for display,

5. prepare a reading log on the resources read including key details (e.g. title, author, main idea, vocabulary),

6. identify sentences written in future tense and note them down,

7. create a reading club with peers and exchange reading resources. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. search for texts related to technology, social media or the internet, using digital devices or the library,
2. collaborate with peers to conduct a silent reading session,
3. list down the vocabulary identified from the read texts,
4. pick out names of digital devices from the texts, read and write them on charts for display,
5. prepare a reading log on the resources read including key details (e.g. title, author, main idea, vocabulary),
6. identify sentences written in future tense and note them down,
7. create a reading club with peers and exchange reading resources. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: This is developed as the learner effectively orders and prioritises tasks when conducting a silent reading

session.

• Digital Literacy: The learner uses digital technology to search for texts related to technology, social media or the internet.

Values:
• Responsibility: This is nurtured as the learner exhibits accountability when manipulating digital devices to find information

related to technology, social media and the use of internet to read.

• Social Justice: This is promoted as the learner advocates for harmonious relationships by creating a reading club with peers

and exchanging reading resources.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Cyber Security: The learner gains skills from texts on how to ensure safety while using the internet.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate the skill on searching for information in extensive reading to the concept of research in all other

subjects.
